# FHE Client

Run all commands from `FHEClient/build`.

```bash
cmake -S .. -B . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/local
cmake --build . -j2

# Creates ../keys_exp1 (all keys) and ../server_keys_exp1 (no secret key).
./FHEClient generate_keys 1

# Only needed to upgrade a keyset generated by an older version.
./FHEClient regenerate_server_keys 1

# Serialize an encrypted 32x32 RGB image.
./FHEClient encrypt 1 ../inputs/knife.png ../ciphertexts/encrypted-input.bin

# Decrypt the two encrypted output logits returned by the server.
./FHEClient decrypt 1 ../ciphertexts/encrypted-result.bin
```

Transfer `server_keys_exp1` and `encrypted-input.bin` to the server. Never
transfer `keys_exp1/secret-key.txt`.
